newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Moody's rates Australia's SMHL bonds Aaa.
newsitem.headline: Moody's rates Australia's SMHL bonds Aaa.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Tuesdday it assigned its Aaa rating to A$180 million in bonds issued by Perpetual Trustees Australia Ltd in its capacity as trustee of the Superannuation Members' Home Loans (SMHL) Securitisation Fund No.5.
The proceeds of the issue will be used primarily to finance mortgage loans to members of the superannuation funds which participated in the SMHL programme.
The SMHL programme is establised by National Mutual Funds Management Ltd and is managed by Superannuation Member's Home Loans Ltd, a wholly owned subsidiary of NMFM Lending Pty Ltd.
